evals.prompt: 帮我写一下这个项目的简历项目经验，我准备找工作了
evals.expected_output: 生成3-5条动词开头的简历项目要点，包含量化数据，基于当前仓库的git历史分析
expectations: The output analyzes git log for the user's commits
The output includes quantified data (commit counts, line changes, time range, or module counts)
The output follows resume format with action-verb-first bullet points
No fabricated metrics — all claims traceable to git data or explicitly marked as 待确认

evals.prompt: 我下周有个面试，帮我准备一下这个项目的口头描述 /path/to/my-project
evals.expected_output: 生成STAR结构的面试口头描述，2-3分钟口语化表达，含具体技术细节和决策过程
expectations: The output follows STAR structure (Situation, Task, Action, Result)
The output is conversational and suitable for spoken delivery
The output includes specific technical details and decision-making rationale
The output is 400-600 Chinese characters in length

evals.prompt: 帮我生成一份述职材料，总结我在这个项目上的贡献
evals.expected_output: 生成包含核心贡献表格、技术深度、跨团队协作和未来规划的述职文档
expectations: The output includes a table of core contributions with quantified data
The output has a section for future planning
The output shows impact scope (team/department/company level)
The output is structured with clear sections matching the 述职 template
